# case: health-caa-critical
## problems
warn zone.lint.CAA_UNKNOWN_TAG {"name":"example.com","tag":"tbs"}
## notes
fix.n.report-ttl {"ttl":3600}
## check
z=example.com&r=is+@+CAA+0+tbs+%22unknown%22%7C0+issue+%22letsencrypt.org%22%5E128+tbs+%22unknown%22%7C0+issue+%22letsencrypt.org%22
## bind
; DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
; The records below are what the changed sets hold afterwards;
; every other record of the zone stays as it is.
$ORIGIN example.com.

; example.com CAA
@ 3600 IN CAA 0 tbs "unknown"
@ 3600 IN CAA 0 issue "letsencrypt.org"
; delete: @ 3600 IN CAA 128 tbs "unknown"
## route53
{
  "Comment": "DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)",
  "Changes": [
    {
      "Action": "UPSERT",
      "ResourceRecordSet": {
        "Name": "example.com.",
        "Type": "CAA",
        "TTL": 3600,
        "ResourceRecords": [
          {
            "Value": "0 tbs \"unknown\""
          },
          {
            "Value": "0 issue \"letsencrypt.org\""
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}
## cloudflare
#!/bin/sh
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# Needs an API token that may edit this zone's DNS records (Zone > DNS > Edit) and the zone ID
# (the zone's Overview page). Neither is written here: set both in your shell first.
: "${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:?set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN to your API token}"
: "${CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID:?set CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID to the zone ID of example.com}"
API="https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID/dns_records"

# 1. Change example.com CAA: 128 tbs "unknown" -> 0 tbs "unknown"
#    Find the record's id, then:
curl -sS "$API?type=CAA&name=example.com" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X PATCH "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"CAA","name":"example.com","data":{"flags":0,"tag":"tbs","value":"unknown"},"ttl":3600}'
## cloudflare notes
fix.fn.cloudflare-ids {}
## octodns
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# In the zone's YAML (example.com.yaml): set these entries; the other names stay as they are.
---
'':
  - ttl: 3600
    type: CAA
    values:
      - flags: 0
        tag: tbs
        value: unknown
      - flags: 0
        tag: issue
        value: letsencrypt.org
## terraform-cloudflare
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# terraform-provider-cloudflare v4 (cloudflare_record; v5 names it cloudflare_dns_record).
variable "cloudflare_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The zone ID of example.com"
}

# change: the resource that holds example.com CAA 128 tbs "unknown" gets the value below

resource "cloudflare_record" "caa_apex" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "example.com"
  type     = "CAA"
  data {
    flags = 0
    tag   = "tbs"
    value = "unknown"
  }
  ttl      = 3600
}

resource "cloudflare_record" "caa_apex_2" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "example.com"
  type     = "CAA"
  data {
    flags = 0
    tag   = "issue"
    value = "letsencrypt.org"
  }
  ttl      = 3600
}
## terraform-route53
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# aws_route53_record manages a whole record set: every value of the name and type is listed.
variable "route53_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The hosted zone ID of example.com"
}

resource "aws_route53_record" "caa_apex" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "example.com"
  type    = "CAA"
  ttl     = 3600
  records = ["0 tbs \"unknown\"", "0 issue \"letsencrypt.org\""]
}
## en
DNS change request: example.com

Please make the following changes in the DNS zone example.com. Records not listed here stay as they are.

1. Replace: CAA records
   Name: example.com
   Values:
     0 tbs "unknown"
     0 issue "letsencrypt.org"
   TTL: 3600
   This removes:
     128 tbs "unknown"

Notes:
- The TTL 3600 is a default: a public resolver does not tell a zone’s own TTL. A record that is only changed can keep the TTL it has.

Once the change is made, this link shows whether public DNS resolvers see it:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.com&r=is+@+CAA+0+tbs+%22unknown%22%7C0+issue+%22letsencrypt.org%22%5E128+tbs+%22unknown%22%7C0+issue+%22letsencrypt.org%22
## tr
DNS değişiklik talebi: example.com

Lütfen example.com DNS zone’unda aşağıdaki değişiklikleri yapın. Burada yer almayan kayıtlar olduğu gibi kalır.

1. Değiştir: CAA kayıtları
   Ad: example.com
   Değerler:
     0 tbs "unknown"
     0 issue "letsencrypt.org"
   TTL: 3600
   Bu değişiklikle kaldırılanlar:
     128 tbs "unknown"

Notlar:
- 3600 TTL değeri varsayılandır: genel bir çözümleyici zone’daki asıl TTL’i bildirmez. Yalnızca değiştirilen bir kayıt mevcut TTL’ini koruyabilir.

Değişiklik yapıldıktan sonra genel DNS çözümleyicilerinin onu görüp görmediğini bu bağlantı gösterir:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.com&r=is+@+CAA+0+tbs+%22unknown%22%7C0+issue+%22letsencrypt.org%22%5E128+tbs+%22unknown%22%7C0+issue+%22letsencrypt.org%22
